_about: Catalog of doeff's real I/O handlers — handlers and assemblies that, once installed, touch the outside world (HTTP, files, child processes, the real clock, sockets, DBs, environment variables, threads, the cluster coordinator). It is the counterpart of the linter's DOEFF131 and DOEFF133; only the entries here may appear in :wraps of :world-handlers. Not listed: handlers that only answer from values (memory, fake, sim, replay), translations that only re-emit effects, and exception types.

_not_listed.doeff_core_effects._handlers:slog_handle: only prints to stderr (the touch-target words have no stdout or stderr)
_not_listed.doeff_cluster._worker.protocol.status_fi: only re-emits file-system effects (MakeDirectory, WriteText) — real I/O is done by the outer os-file-handler (#2466)
_not_listed.doeff_cluster._record_store.protocol.rec: only re-emits file-system effects — real I/O is done by the outer os-file-handler (record_store.entry.main)
_not_listed.doeff_cluster._worker.protocol.tree_file: only re-emits tree effects as file-system effects and slog — in production os-file-handler answers, in the mock world memory-file-handler answers (the real responder was retired in #2468)
_not_listed.doeff_cluster._foundation.record_handler: the sink is injected (values only for MemorySink) — sending to the store only re-emits HttpRequest (real I/O is done by the outer http-production-handler, #2583)
_not_listed.doeff_records._pg:pg-records-handler: only re-emits SqlQuery (the real DB is handled by postgres-sql-handler)
_not_listed.doeff_core_effects._scheduler:scheduled: the shared scheduler (laid under every Program, mock ones included) — the environment variable is only an implementation choice and time.monotonic is only a stall watchdog; it does not answer effects from the outside world
_not_listed.doeff_cluster._worker.protocol.world:loc: only asks ObserveWorld for the observation of each rephrasing and gathers them (#2469)
_not_listed.doeff_cluster._worker.protocol.code_stor: only re-emits the per-version code tree as child-process and file-system effects — real I/O is done by subprocess-handler and os-file-handler (#2466)
_not_listed.doeff_cluster._worker.protocol.env_store: only re-emits the root of the execution environment as child-process and file-system effects — real I/O is done by subprocess-handler and os-file-handler (#2467)
_not_listed.doeff_cluster._worker.protocol.coordinat: only re-emits heartbeat, Program fetching, and named waits as HttpRequest and file effects on the destination part — real I/O is done by http-production-handler and os-file-handler (#2427)
_not_listed.doeff_cluster._worker.protocol.lease_rel: only re-emits the lease return as HttpRequest on the destination part (#2427)
_not_listed.doeff_cluster._worker.entry.drain_main:c: only re-emits the drain query as HttpRequest on the destination part (#2427)
